source: EnergyPlus Engineering Reference (2023), Boiler:HotWater; Stafford (2009), Energy and Buildings 41(2) 168-175

eta_nom.notes: 0.95 typical for modern condensing gas boiler (ErP A-rated)

a0.description: Constant term in part-load efficiency polynomial
a0.notes: a0+a1+a2 must equal 1.0; EnergyPlus Boiler:HotWater convention

a1.description: Linear term in part-load efficiency polynomial
a1.notes: Dominant term: nearly linear part-load behaviour

a2.description: Quadratic term in part-load efficiency polynomial
a2.notes: Zero for linear curve; increase for convex curve

PLR_min.notes: Below PLR_min, boiler cycles on/off; model clamps to PLR_min

LHV_gas.description: Lower heating value of natural gas
LHV_gas.notes: 36.6 MJ/m³ ~ 10.17 kWh/m³ for typical UK/EU natural gas
